purpose: Admit the qualified directory-file collector to existing retained-frame/snapshot and owned-worker mechanisms before public frontend use.
existing_facts: NtfsSnapshotInput and NtfsWorker currently bind bootstrap inputs/results with strict v1 shapes. NtfsFileSnapshot holds immutable result/context/frame after actual owned child exit.

The common ObservationWorker already supplies process/job/mapping lifetime, bounded waits/cancel/retirement and actual process/epoch/code binding. Extend its NTFS profile; do not build another scheduler or duplicate opener.

The existing frame budget is8MiB and worker budget128MiB. Directory source limits remain unchanged. Compute and test complete frame bounds from retained raw bytes, hex expansion, result and metadata before choosing wire limits.
required_contract_decisions_before_code: Choose a typed directory input/mode and explicit private wire identity while preserving existing default bootstrap shapes, field meanings and tests. Bind full requested reference, directory limits, capture epoch, source metadata/window and automatic/explicit profile.

Parent verification must reconstruct the selected directory report, original3.1 probe and3.0 prefix-validation boundary/foundation hashes from retained responses. Derive prefix response count from replay; do not trust the child declaration. Check exact consumption, phase counts, domain, provenance, flags and all unsupported authority claims.

Keep structurally valid incomplete/changed/cancelled observations inspectable without making them applicable. Reject profile/replay/provenance corruption rather than repairing claims. Public frontend/namespace/content admission remains separate.

Retain actual launch/PID/creation/code/request/attempt/capture identity, publication digest, process exit and dependency lifetime. No live or uncertain worker yields an admitted usable result. Handle cancellation, timeout, late publication, malformed frames and finite retirement through the existing host.

Exercise generated root/multilevel/fragmented/list/bitmap files, both profiles including automatic3.0, exact replay/foundation/domain faults, input/limit/ref/source/process corruption, partial reader failures and actual process lifecycle. Normal binaries must reject test controls. Preserve old NTFS bootstrap/command/worker and common-worker regressions.
